answer: The comet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the tundra. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, diluted when peers disagree, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The gale of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
